decisions.reason: Adding B-roll as a required source does not alter the complete-moment standard; the message's new audience-comprehension rule is already captured by a separate same-message MODIFY.
The source-selection change does not affect clip duration, and the stated 45-to-60-second range already exists in the candidate state.
Requiring B-roll does not change caption color, font, or effects; the message reiterates the existing white-text and no-effects rules.
The addition of B-roll does not change the existing clean, simple editing standard; no-heavy-animation and no-flashy-transition language reiterates current values.
The B-roll source change does not alter publishing eligibility or destination, and the independent Friday schedule and late-delivery policy are already captured by a same-message MODIFY.
A five-clip current batch using B-roll does not modify or resume the deferred requirement for 100 approved clips per month.

The source-selection change itself does not alter submission workflow, while the message's independent folder, access, batch-size, and deadline instructions are already fully captured by a same-message MODIFY.
Adding B-roll as source material does not change the requirement to select strong, high-quality moments.
The clip-source update has no necessary effect on Lead Clipper training, advancement, compensation, or responsibilities.
The request for five first real clips does not explicitly revise the existing qualification method, success condition, clip count, or deadline.
The message reiterates that clips require client approval before publication but does not change the existing approval authority, publication eligibility, or rejected-clip handling.
The B-roll source decision does not establish or change any progress or delay communication requirement.
